item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:35 HKT 30/Aug/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The weather will be very hot with light winds over Guangdong in the next couple of days, while showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will affect the region. A dry continental airstream is expected to affect southern China towards the weekend and early next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Hinnamnor will move in the general direction of the vicinity of the Ryukyu Islands in the next couple of days.
